summary: Global variables carry a module prefix
Identifiers at most 31 characters (declarations/functions/macros; not parameters or members)
File-scope static variables start with l_
No leading underscore; no C-reserved prefixes for external names
No raw C integer types (stdint or AUTOSAR types)
Std_ReturnType functions return E_OK/E_NOT_OK (literal returns only)
File header comment with purpose/author/date (checks author and date)
Doxygen comment before each function (requirement ID if koosys.requirementIdPattern is set)
No global data definitions in header files
Preprocessor limited to includes and simple macros
Loops have a fixed upper limit (flags for(;;)/while(1) only)
Functions no longer than one page (koosys.maxFunctionLines)
At least two assertions per function (koosys.assertionMacros)
DOS 8.3 file names (contradicts KooSys 4.1 example module_name.c)
Declare variables at the beginning of a block
Use const where appropriate (cppcheck constVariable is not reported)
One module per C file with a descriptive name
Comments describe intention; complex code commented
Ownership and lifetime of parameters documented
Direct address writes aligned with the SW architect
Minimise memory use and copying; critical sections
Compile with the strictest compiler warnings
